title: Compute the hash of a file
description: Compute the cryptographic fingerprint (SHA256 hash) of a file to check its integrity.
notes:
Windows: Get-FileHash supports SHA256 (default), SHA1, SHA384, SHA512, MD5.
Linux: sha256sum is part of coreutils. Alternatives: sha1sum, sha512sum, md5sum.
